scope: 100000 deterministic random-256 keys, three AB pairs per extraction/public50-50 hit-miss lookup/fresh-tree insert; no broadened matrix.
checksum_validation: Every sample validates against its expected pass checksum; baseline/candidate checksum per operation also matches exactly in all nine pairs.
settings: identical normalized compile and link settings; separate preserved baseline/candidate libraries, exact hashes in benchmark/BUILD.json
no_fold: Runtime-seeded inputs, shuffled schedule, compiler barriers on extraction inputs and observed results, consumed/validated checksum; candidate timed assembly retains direct uint32 load/shift/mask rather than precomputed constant.
timer_scope: Active timer covers operation loops, including actual insert node allocation/CAS/RCU. Entry preparation, tree lifecycle, validation and reclamation are outside insertion active time. Raw wall time includes those loop-adjacent costs; setup corpus creation is outside both.
performance_scope: Single-host warm synthetic microbenchmarks. No daemon admission TPS, network convergence, combined-speedup or platform-wide claim.
